content: PAPER DELIVERED 2026-05-18: The Narrowing -- Why the Best Evidence for Medical Cannabis Keeps Getting Smaller. Markdown master + typeset 9-page A4 PDF (TeX Gyre Termes via xelatex; Lora failed on bold-variant font resolution AND Greek glyph coverage, switched to Termes which has full family + Greek -- a small verify-the-toolchain-not-just-the-content lesson). Hybrid structure led by the asymmetry thesis: the breadth of a cannabis claim is empirically inversely related to the quality of evidence under it (the narrowing); cannabis is the worked case, the method is the contribution. 10 sections: opens on the Epidiolex mechanism-unknown paradox, states method so it can be used against us, ECS spine with plausible-tier discipline, indication ledger (one strong claim / three qualified / graveyard exhumed to main text), pain as threshold-artifact + openly-labeled values judgment, psychosis as warning-survives-attenuation with the skeptical-overreach mirror named, entourage as three-claims-conflated, and Section 8 -- the confession: documents the Vaucher/Gage miscitation that 3 systems propagated in convergence and the verification pass caught, presented prominently as the best evidence FOR the method rather than minimized. Voice: human, no em dashes (hard constraint held throughout), dry wit earned from the material not bolted on (hide the bodies / sitting cheerfully on the null / the same sin in the other coat). All v2 corrections carried; PK-entourage stays quarantined-unverified in-text; pain values-judgment labeled not smuggled. Caveats section preserves every limitation including the embargoed-Cochrane secondary-paraphrase dependency. This is the publishable distillation of the entire multi-pass arc.
